qualifier: very long-chain and essential polyunsaturated (linoleic/alpha-linolenic) fatty acids
name: Elongation of very long-chain and essential polyunsaturated fatty acids
rationale: All members concern biosynthetic elongation of saturated very long-chain acyl-CoAs or linoleic/alpha-linolenic acid metabolism, whereas confusables centre on peroxisomal alpha/beta-oxidation or ether lipid and wax synthesis.

qualifier: defensins and anti-nematode response
name: Mucosal defensin-mediated antimicrobial and anti-nematode defence
rationale: Members cover defensins, cytolysis and agglutination of microbes, mucosal innate immunity and bacterial attachment to epithelium; chitin metabolism and response to nematodes distinguish it from the antibacterial-peptide and metal-sequestration confusables.

core: Pathogen subversion of host cell defences
qualifier: macrophage survival strategies and bacterial toxin uptake
name: Pathogen subversion of macrophage defences and toxin uptake
rationale: Members describe how pathogens (Mtb, Leishmania, toxins, SARS) suppress autophagy, apoptosis, NO, phagolysosome fusion and membrane repair in host cells, unlike confusables about bacterial entry, phagosome acidification or anti-inflammatory macrophage signalling.

qualifier: TNFR1 signalling via linear polyubiquitination
name: TNFR1-NF-kappaB signalling regulation by linear polyubiquitination
rationale: Members regulate canonical and non-canonical NF-kappaB and transcription factor activity downstream of TNFR1, with linear ubiquitination, distinguishing it from deubiquitinase, SUMO, IKK-recruitment and NIK-driven confusables.

core: Drug disposition by organic ion transport
qualifier: SLC22 and SLCO organic anion and cation transporters
name: Drug disposition by SLC organic anion and cation transporters
rationale: Members cover organic anion/cation transport and the ADME of drugs handled by SLC22 and SLCO carriers, whereas confusables emphasise bilirubin conjugation defects and xenobiotic barrier transport.

qualifier: Polycomb BMI1 silencing and secretory phenotype
name: Stress-induced senescence with Polycomb silencing and SASP
rationale: Members concern oxidative/stress-induced premature senescence, SASP and BMI1 Polycomb repression of cell-cycle loci, distinguishing it from oncogene-induced, replicative, UV-response and p53-apoptosis confusables.

qualifier: tubulin glutamylation and microtubule severing
name: Chaperonin folding of tubulin and actin, tubulin glutamylation
rationale: Members cover prefoldin/TRiC folding of tubulin, actin and G-beta plus tubulin C-terminal glutamylation and microtubule severing, separating it from general chaperone refolding/ER folding and tubulin acetylation confusables.

core: Fucose metabolism and fucosylated glycan synthesis
qualifier: blood-group antigens and sulfated selectin ligands
name: Fucose metabolism for blood-group antigens and selectin ligands
rationale: Members span GDP-fucose synthesis, ABO/Lewis antigen synthesis and tyrosine sulfation supporting leukocyte/HSC selectin-mediated tethering, unlike confusables on sialylation, O/N-glycan processing and nucleotide-sugar transporter defects.

qualifier: potassium channels and inherited SLC12 disorders
name: Cation-chloride cotransporters, potassium channels and inherited defects
rationale: Members are SLC12 cation-chloride cotransporters, their Bartter/Gitelman/ACCPN defects, potassium channels and anion homeostasis, distinct from sodium-transport regulation, osmosensing, magnesium paracellular and SLC26 anion-exchange confusables.

qualifier: TAK1-driven AP-1 immediate-early response
name: TAK1-JNK/p38 stress kinase signalling and AP-1 immediate-early response
rationale: Members regulate JNK/p38 cascades via TAK1 and the AP-1/NR4A immediate-early gene response, distinguishing it from UV-response, ERK negative-feedback and alpha-kinase confusables.

qualifier: gastric secretion, gut motility and itch
name: Histamine signalling in gastric secretion, gut motility and itch
rationale: Members cover histamine metabolism, receptors and responses in gastric acid secretion, GI smooth muscle, stomach development, itch and TRP channels, unlike serotonin, acetylcholine and tachykinin smooth-muscle confusables.

qualifier: cancer-associated MMR gene defects
name: DNA mismatch repair and its cancer-associated defects
rationale: All members concern MutS/MutL mismatch repair, repeat maintenance and its MLH1/MSH/PMS2 or MSI-linked mutant defects, distinct from base excision, double-strand break repair and somatic hypermutation confusables.

qualifier: chain-type ubiquitination, deubiquitination and misfolded-protein quality control
name: Ubiquitin-proteasome degradation, deubiquitination and misfolded-protein quality control
rationale: Members span E1/E2/E3 chain-specific ubiquitination, DUB families, proteasome assembly, ERAD, aggrephagy and chaperone-mediated autophagy, distinguishing it from chaperonin folding, neddylation and ribosome-stall confusables.

qualifier: fibril formation and APP production
name: Regulation of amyloid fibril formation and APP production
rationale: Members regulate amyloid fibril and tangle formation and APP synthesis/catabolism, distinguishing it from amyloid-beta clearance and glial activation confusables.

qualifier: calcium-triggered vesicle exocytosis and its modulation
name: Presynaptic calcium-triggered neurotransmitter release and its modulation
rationale: Members cover neurotransmitter release cycles, vesicle docking/priming/fusion, presynaptic calcium and G-protein modulation, unlike vesicle-recycling and postsynaptic AMPA/kainate confusables.

qualifier: MITF-M control and pigment organelle biogenesis
name: MITF-driven melanocyte programme and pigment organelle biogenesis
rationale: Members cover MITF-M target genes, melanin synthesis, melanosome and related-organelle (dense granule) biogenesis and eye pigmentation, distinct from keratinocyte, intestinal epithelium and UV-response confusables.

qualifier: synovial inflammation
name: Monocyte-endothelial adhesion control in synovial inflammation
rationale: Members regulate monocyte activation/aggregation, leukocyte endothelial adhesion and extravasation with synoviocyte proliferation, hyaluronan and MMP secretion, unlike chemotaxis, integrin and cytokine confusables.

qualifier: adipocyte lipid droplet dynamics
name: Adipocyte triglyceride storage, lipolysis and lipid droplet dynamics
rationale: Members cover PA/DAG/TAG synthesis, lipid droplet formation and breakdown, lipolysis and adipogenesis, distinct from lipogenesis, fatty acid oxidation and phosphatidylcholine-synthesis confusables.

qualifier: renal sodium handling and potassium response
name: Regulation of renal sodium and potassium transmembrane transport
rationale: Members regulate sodium export/import and potassium import, renal sodium transport and response to potassium, unlike P-type ATPase, chloride cotransporter, osmosensing and magnesium confusables.

qualifier: zygotic mRNA clearance and pronuclear reprogramming
name: Maternal-to-zygotic transition with zygotic mRNA clearance and pronuclear reprogramming
rationale: Members cover MZT, Z-decay, pronuclear epigenetic programming, maternal protein storage and cleavage, distinguishing it from maternal-factor M-decay and ZGA/germline piRNA confusables.

qualifier: synthesis, catabolism and cellular response
name: Retinoic acid synthesis, catabolism and cellular response
rationale: Members cover retinal-to-retinoic acid synthesis, CYP26-mediated degradation and responses to retinoic acid/vitamin A, unlike vitamin D, steroid hormone and retinol transport confusables.

qualifier: exosome-mediated surveillance of noncoding RNAs
name: Nuclear RNA exosome 3'-end processing and RNA surveillance
rationale: Members cover 3'-to-5' trimming and decay of snRNA, snoRNA, rRNA, tRNA, CUTs and nuclear mRNA, distinct from cytoplasmic NMD/ribosome-rescue and endonucleolytic rRNA processing confusables.

qualifier: end processing, splicing and small RNA biogenesis
name: Nuclear tRNA end processing, splicing and small-RNA biogenesis
rationale: Members cover tRNA 5'/3' processing, intron splicing and tRF and siRNA biogenesis, distinguishing it from mitochondrial RNA processing and exosome decay confusables.

qualifier: nucleotide pool sanitization and nucleoside analogue drug metabolism
name: Nucleotide pool sanitization and nucleoside analogue drug metabolism
rationale: Members cover NUDT-mediated triphosphate hydrolysis protecting DNA and metabolism/methylation of thiopurine and antiviral nucleoside analogues, unlike de novo purine synthesis, purine/pyrimidine catabolism and nucleoside transport confusables.

qualifier: oxidized lipoprotein uptake and foam cell formation
name: Scavenger receptor clearance of oxidized lipoproteins, foam cell formation
rationale: Members cover class A/B/F/H scavenger receptors, oxLDL responses, cholesterol storage and foam cell differentiation, distinct from cholesterol efflux and apoptotic-cell or amyloid clearance confusables.
